summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares an AJAX-handler utility purpose but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<archive>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle at the tarball root using string-array rotation (rotation helper WV8StW, mangled identifiers MmgoCP/etDiOOB/n7gIxM) with no readable strings, no source map, and no relationship to AJAX handling. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with _0xXXXX-style identifier mangling despite being a small orchestration script. package.json's `files` field lists only `dist` and `src`, so math_init.js is shipped adjacent to the manifest-declared surface. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching a second JS runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated in-tarball payload that scanners inspecting Node-resolved code will miss. Every consumer running `npm install` on this version auto-executes the obfuscated bundle under the downloaded Bun binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
